title: NPC Animation Loop Pass
body:
The current NPC rig is going through a side-by-side animation check. The showcase keeps the supervisor, contractor, and enforcer variants aligned across walk, run, shoot, and bat-hit actions so their timing and silhouettes can be compared under the same camera.

Walk and run stay in continuous loops. Shoot and bat hit play as complete actions, return to a readable rest pose, and then repeat. That makes the loop boundaries, weapon alignment, and full follow-through easier to inspect.

This is an isolated validation scene rather than a combat pass. The focus is clean motion, grounded feet, readable poses, and consistent results across all three character fits.

[video: Twelve NPC variants arranged in walk, run, shoot, and bat-hit columns for a side-by-side animation loop check.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-07-12-npc-animation-loop-pass/rightslock-rigging-showcase.mp4)
